title: Ordinary exchange on an affine-open pushforward
statement: Let A,B be commutative rings, f:X→Spec A a separated morphism, g:Spec B→Spec A, G a quasi-coherent module on X, and W an affine open of X. With the canonical pullback square of f and g, the ordinary module base change map [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction] on W.ι_*(G restricted to W) is an isomorphism. No complex, derived category, product, or localization appears.

proof.text: Write j=W.ι, p=pullback.fst f g and f'=pullback.snd f g. Form the cartesian square for j along p and paste it above the square for f along g. Since f is separated over affine Spec A, X is separated. An affine-open inclusion in a separated scheme is affine; j≫f has affine source and target and hence is affine. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence.
Apply affinePushforward_baseChange to G|W in the square for j and in the outer square for j≫f. Both exchange maps are invertible.

Transpose under the tensor-pullback adjunction for g. The adjoint of exchange is pushforward of the pullback unit followed by pushforward composition. Naturality of the unit and sectionwise associativity of pushforward identify the outer adjoint with the adjoint of exchange for f on j_*G|W followed by f'_* of exchange for j, with the canonical pushforward-composition isomorphisms at the ends. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence proves vertical pasting. Cancel f'_* of exchange for j and the composition isomorphisms to conclude.

lean.statement:
theorem affineOpen_pushforward_exchange
    {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A)
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G]
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    IsIso (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
      (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).obj (G.restrict W.ι)))
